summary: Iteration 11 testing: DM messaging (send/threads/thread/search/unread/read-receipts), 7-kind attachments with enrichment, new_message notification (throttled), auction_ending notification (idempotent), and end-to-end frontend UX for inbox, thread, attachment preview/removal, and notification click-through to /messages/{from_user_id}. 16/16 backend pytest passing. All frontend flows verified in a real browser session.

minor.issue: Reads db.auction_watchers but the rest of the codebase writes/reads db.watchers. Watchers therefore never receive 'auction_ending' notifications — only the current bidder does. Change line 188 in /app/backend/auctions.py to `db.watchers` for consistency.

action_items: Fix _check_ending_soon watcher collection name (db.auction_watchers → db.watchers) in /app/backend/auctions.py so auction-watchers get the 1h-ending notification, not just the current bidder.
critical_code_review_comments: auctions.py _check_ending_soon uses `db.auction_watchers` collection whereas the watch/unwatch endpoints and _check_deadline_warning use `db.watchers`. Watchers won't receive 'auction_ending' notifications until this is unified.

messages.py POST /messages fires 'new_message' notification but never enriches artist name or artwork on the notification doc — the /notifications enrichment handler picks up from_user_id → other, which works. Good.

messages.py get_thread does a bulk update_many then iterates the ALREADY-fetched `raw` list and mutates each doc's read status locally; this is correct because raw was fetched before the update. Just noting the ordering guarantee.
Messages.js MessageThread polls the thread every 5s via setInterval — good for read-receipt refresh; consider WebSocket in future for lower latency and to reduce load.
Attachment enrichment for the 'artwork' kind sets image=(a['images'] or [None])[0]; if images is [] and title is None the frontend AttachmentCard may render empty. Minor edge case.
test_credentials: Uses /api/auth/register to create isolated per-test users; admin creds unused.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates its own artist/buyer/artwork; auction test uses direct pymongo write to force artwork status='live' and to set end_at 30min in future.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_messaging_iter11.py is fully self-contained and can be reused. If retesting auction_ending after the db.watchers fix, add a watcher via POST /auctions/{id}/watch before triggering GET /auctions/{id} and assert the watcher also receives kind='auction_ending'. Frontend Messages.js and Notifications.js are fully wired for new_message routing.
